cues: Integration runs differentiation backwards, with a plus C. Substitution undoes the chain rule, parts undoes the product rule.
The standard forms and partial fractions handle the rest.
The definite integral is a signed area, and the area between curves is the integral of top minus bottom.
text: Quick recap. Integration runs differentiation backwards, with a plus C. Substitution undoes the chain rule, parts undoes the product rule.
